market: Stressed in the body (snapping, tense, foggy, racing mind)
line: Snapping at everyone isn't a patience problem. It's a stress hormone running on the wrong clock.
first_test: Opener swap on best UGC; Calm/Headspace/meditation interests
kpi: Hook rate; stop at -20% vs control after 3-5k impressions
evidence: Calm 2.57M visits/mo, 9,529 videos; its #1 and #2 ads by impressions are biology-not-willpower reframes; top spend Sept-Oct on 'burnout is a nervous system stuck in survival mode'; no Calm ad says cortisol
dont_say: No anxiety-disorder or mood claims; never 'apps don't work'

market: Coffee swappers (tired, bloated, puffy coffee drinkers)
line: You already swapped your coffee to calm your stress. Keep the cup. Cortisol gets its own formula.
first_test: New opener on best body; mushroom-coffee and adaptogen interests
kpi: Hook rate, CTR; stop below baseline at 10k impressions
evidence: RYZE 3.59M visits/mo, 8,726 videos, 625 winners; fit confirmed 46%; cortisol-belly winners 110-124d (batch retired)
dont_say: Never attack coffee or mushrooms; no gut claims; no water-retention promises

market: Connected symptoms (puffy face, tired after 8 h, cravings, bloating)
line: You've been taking ashwagandha for cortisol. Here's the full morning formula, at the doses studied.
first_test: New 3-5 s opener on AVIA's best UGC symptom ad; Goli/ashwagandha/gummy interests
kpi: Hook rate vs control at 5k impressions; CPA
evidence: Goli 486k visits/mo, 213 winners; fit confirmed 44%; its #1 ad by impressions and October creator ads now name cortisol, so the idea is less new
dont_say: Gut/microbiome, ACV, B12, NAD+; body-shaming lines; never 'gummies don't work'

line: Your bloodwork came back normal. It still doesn't explain 3 pm.
first_test: Opener on best talking head; women's telehealth and at-home lab interests
evidence: hers 4.38M visits/mo, 2,242 videos, only 40 winners; genuine bridge 6/46 (13%); weight winners are GLP-1 price ads
dont_say: No lab interpretation; no prescription or drug-price comparisons; no anxiety treatment

line: You've got the wind-down covered. So why do you still wake up exhausted? Stress is also a hormone, and its day starts in the morning.
first_test: Opener on best UGC; weighted-blanket interests
evidence: Bearaby 201k visits/mo, 1,017 videos, 291 winners; fit partial 18% (7 of 10 transcribed blanket winners); founder 'stress hormone cortisol' 90d
dont_say: No sleep/insomnia/hot-flash claims; no deep-pressure or melatonin claims

line: I've done the points three times. Nobody once asked me about my stress.
first_test: Later: a midlife 'biology, not willpower' opener
evidence: WeightWatchers 2.5M visits/mo; original sample 1/50 voiced stress; top-impression top-up adds a midlife 'hormones shift, that is biology not willpower' script and 'food noise' ads
dont_say: No weight numbers; no GLP-1; never 'diets fail'

line: You've got the macros and the lifting down. Nobody coached the stress hormone that wakes you at 3 a.m.
first_format: Grandmother explainer (169d) as the full ad
first_test: Opener on mechanism video; strength/macros/menopause interests
evidence: WarriorBabe 167k visits/mo; fit partial; its new top protein script already says 'sleep improves because cortisol stabilizes'
dont_say: No weight numbers; no GLP-1 comparisons; 'metabolic memory' is theirs

line: You found something for your hair. What are you doing about the year that caused it?
first_format: Opener with no hair visuals after the hook
first_test: Only after the first three markets; hair-vitamin and red-light interests
kpi: Hook rate ≥ +10% vs control or stop
evidence: MaryRuth's 659k and iRESTORE 667k visits/mo; genuine stress-hair scripts: iRESTORE 1 (155d), MaryRuth's 0 winners (October tests only)

first_test: None: watch Stress Reset as a competitor
evidence: Thesis Stress Reset is now a cortisol product in its top 34 ads by impressions

line: You've already heard it's cortisol. AVIA Cortisol Detox is built around it, from the first ingredient to the seventh.
first_test: Defensive: brand every cortisol-detox ad; no separate market test
kpi: Branded search; CPA on 'cortisol detox' audiences
evidence: Bioma 1.05M visits/mo, 439 winners; CORTISOL DETOX family 165-167d (9 of 40 winners); stress→cortisol test 22 Oct
dont_say: Gut signalling, GLP-1, poop/toxin, pound counts
